name: Warning Sign
look: A square orange warning sign with a thin black border. A black band across the top holds a red oval outlined in orange with the word "Warning" in bold black letters. The rest of the sign is a large blank orange area.
use: Your text goes in the blank orange area as a joke warning about yourself, someone else or a situation, written like an official safety notice.
examples: Do not talk to me before my first coffee
May contain unsolicited opinions about pizza toppings
describe: orange sign with a red oval at the top and blank space
